title: Magna theme design tokens (tokens.json)
description: Categories of design tokens, compiled by Magna Pages to CSS custom properties: colors.primary → --color-primary; every other category uses the kebab-cased key alone (layout.maxWidth → --max-width). Values may not contain ; ( < or > — no rgb(), hsl(), calc(), clamp(), var() or url().

additionalProperties.description: A category of tokens. Name it freely; only "colors" is special (its variables get a color- prefix).

dark.description: The dark reading. Tokens without one are the same in both schemes.

label.description: Human name for documentation and tooling.
